title: Group OSCORE key distribution (spec 18.8.5)
description: Gap 6 of a6qg: group OSCORE key distribution entirely absent from python/src/lichen (no pairwise wrap, no key_epoch counter, no 1-hour grace window, no epoch rollback/future rejection, no membership rekey). 9/10 vectors in test/vectors/group_oscore_key.json UNDRIVABLE (skipped in test_security_app_vector_consumers.py). Spec: RFC 9203 group OSCORE; GET /groups/<id>/key CBOR {key_id, algorithm, expires}; key delivery only over existing pairwise OSCORE (EDHOC-established); rekey on removal: new master_secret, increment key_epoch, distribute via pairwise OSCORE, old epoch rejected after 1-hour grace. Decomposed into child beads; close this epic when all children + the vector consumer bead are done.
